# LIHI (Low Income Housing Institute)

> > LIHI provides affordable housing, permanent supportive housing, and homeless services across Seattle and Washington State.

The Low Income Housing Institute operates numerous properties including senior housing, veteran-focused units, and permanent supportive housing developments throughout the Puget Sound region. LIHI also offers innovative housing solutions like tiny house villages and works with HUD, the City of Seattle, and other partners to address homelessness.

- LIHI (Low Income Housing Institute)

## Permanent Supportive Housing Properties

- [Dockside Apartments](https://www.lihihousing.org/properties/dockside-apartments): Dockside Apartments: permanent supportive housing near Green Lake
- [Gossett Place](https://www.lihihousing.org/properties/gossett-place): Gossett Place: veterans & young adults supportive housing in U-District
- [Unity Commons](https://www.lihihousing.org/properties/unity-commons): Unity Commons: permanent supportive housing in Olympia, WA

## Specialized Housing Programs

- [Cheryl Chow Court Apartments](https://www.lihihousing.org/properties/cheryl-chow-court-apartments): Senior housing at Cheryl Chow Court Apartments in Ballard, Seattle
- [Clay Apartments](https://www.lihihousing.org/properties/clay-apartments): Clay Apartments: Section 8 studios for veterans & homeless in Seattle
- [John Fox Place](https://www.lihihousing.org/properties/john-fox-place): John Fox Place affordable apartments on Aurora Ave, Licton Springs

## Resources & Documentation

- [Tiny House Designs and Documents](https://www.lihihousing.org/tinyhousedesigns): Tiny house construction plans, documents & volunteer build guides
